title: BigBasket Grocery Scraper Input
description: Search BigBasket or scrape public grocery category pages. Defaults save one in-stock milk result for a low-cost test.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: One or more grocery searches. Duplicate products are removed across all sources.

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Optional BigBasket category URLs, such as https://www.bigbasket.com/pc/fruits-vegetables/fresh-vegetables/

brands.title: Brand filter
brands.description: Optional exact brand names. Matching is case-insensitive.

inStockOnly.title: In-stock products only
inStockOnly.description: Exclude products marked unavailable or not for sale. Keep enabled for smaller, cleaner test runs.

maxResults.title: Maximum products
maxResults.description: Maximum unique products saved across the complete run. Start with 1 to keep usage low.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Maximum result pages requested for each keyword or category URL. Start with 1 for a small test run.

trackChanges.title: Track price and stock changes
trackChanges.description: Compare saved products within the same source context and pack identity, retaining a bounded observation history. Comparisons are suppressed when source context cannot be linked.

trackingStoreName.title: Tracking store name
trackingStoreName.description: Persistent store used when change tracking is enabled. Use one schedule per store and monitoring context; overlapping writers are not supported.

trackingRegion.title: Monitoring context label
trackingRegion.description: A stable label that isolates tracking workflows. This label does not select a delivery location or verify fulfillment.

expectedPincode.title: Expected source pincode
expectedPincode.description: Optional six-digit pincode guard. Fail the run if the anonymous storefront reports a different or unavailable source pincode. Does not select a delivery location or verify fulfillment.

historyLimit.title: Observations retained per product
historyLimit.description: Keep the latest saved observations within a comparable source and pack context. This is a bounded sample, not a complete market history.

includeHistory.title: Include history in product rows
includeHistory.description: When tracking is enabled, also export the bounded priceHistory array. History is retained in snapshots even when this is disabled.

priceChangeThresholdPercent.title: Minimum price change percent
priceChangeThresholdPercent.description: Minimum absolute percentage change that triggers a price alert. Both percentage and absolute thresholds must pass. Zero disables this threshold; change fields remain available below it.

priceChangeThresholdAbsolute.title: Minimum price change in INR
priceChangeThresholdAbsolute.description: Minimum absolute INR change that triggers a price alert. Both percentage and absolute thresholds must pass. Zero disables this threshold.

alertOnStockChanges.title: Alert on observed stock changes
alertOnStockChanges.description: Trigger alerts when a returned product changes between available and unavailable. A product missing from a listing is not treated as out of stock. Use inStockOnly=false to retain unavailable rows.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: India residential proxies can improve request reliability. Proxy country does not select a delivery pincode or verify fulfillment; check the source-context fields.
